titulo: Advertising and Marketing vocabulary + Making presentations (temario 1er cuatrimestre)
resumen:
Advertising is the activity or profession of producing information for promoting the sale of commercial products (p. 1).
Marketing is the management process through which goods and services move from concept to the customer, coordinating the 4 P's (p. 2-3).
Key vocabulary: advertisement, advertiser, campaign, billboard, brand, buyer, commercial, consumer, logo, purchase, slogan (p. 16).
Advertising strategies: ideal kids or families, family fun, excitement, star power, repetition, sounds good, cartoon characters, 'are you cool enough?' (p. 21-22).
Making presentations: six hot tips for public speaking, eye contact and a planning chart (Making presentations.docx).
Oral skill practice: design your own product (name, price, target audience, slogan, uniqueness) and present it (Design your own product).
